verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance platform, so HR-synced onboarding and offboarding checklists are a fair axis. The evidence shows no HR integration, no onboarding or offboarding checklists, and no security-training tracking. The only related items are adjacent: MDM remote actions for devices being offboarded, and monitoring of user accounts and access in Google Workspace and GitHub. Neither is the HR-synced checklist workflow the story describes.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
